Name: SkinType
What it means, in normal words: Oily, dry, normal, combination

Name: Sensitivity
What it means, in normal words: Sensitive or not

Name: SkinConcern
What it means, in normal words: Acne, dryness, redness, dark marks, wrinkles, dullness, pores, oiliness
Where I got it from: Ours, but I want to line these up with DermO

Name: Benefit
What it means, in normal words: Hydrating, brightening, soothing. These are just words people use, not logical classes, so SKOS not OWL

Name: IngredientFunction
What it means, in normal words: What an ingredient does: emollient, humectant, preservative, UV filter, surfactant, antioxidant, solvent, and so on

Name: RegulatoryStatus
What it means, in normal words: Banned (Annex II), restricted (III), allowed colorant (IV), preservative (V), UV filter (VI), and the 26 allergens you must declare

Name: Annex
What it means, in normal words: AnnexII through AnnexVI. These are specific entries, not kinds of thing, so they're individuals not classes
Where I got it from: The Noy & McGuinness rule of thumb

Name: Authority
What it means, in normal words: European Commission, SCCS, and later maybe the Lebanese Ministry of Health. Somebody always GRANTS a status
Where I got it from: Borrowed from the halal flavouring ontology

Name: Product
What it means, in normal words: The thing on the shelf. Underneath: Cleanser, Moisturiser (with SunCare under it), Serum, Toner, Exfoliant, Mask, EyeCare, Treatment
Where I got it from: schema:Product, and the breakdown from Abesova

Name: Ingredient
What it means, in normal words: One per CosIng entry, named by its register ID and not by its spelling

Name: IngredientListing
What it means, in normal words: An ingredient AT A POSITION in one product's list. We need this because INCI order tells you roughly how much is in there, and a plain triple has nowhere to put the position

Name: Brand
What it means, in normal words: Who makes it

Name: Offer
What it means, in normal words: One price, one shop, one date. Kept SEPARATE from the product, which is how one lotion holds two Beirut prices at once

Name: Shop
What it means, in normal words: Online or a real shop

Name: Country
What it means, in normal words: Where a brand or a shop is

Name: Claim
What it means, in normal words: A statement about a product carrying who said it, where, when, the exact sentence, and how much that source is worth. THIS IS THE CONTRIBUTION
Where I got it from: PROV-O, specialised. O'Sullivan 2025 did the same thing

Name: EvidenceLevel
What it means, in normal words: Manufacturer said it (1), a shop said it (2), something weaker said it (3), we worked it out from the formula (4)

Name: prov:Agent
What it means, in normal words: Whoever made the claim: a manufacturer, a retailer, or our own inference

Name: LebaneseShop
What it means, in normal words: A shop that actually sells here

Name: ConsumerNeed
What it means, in normal words: A need as its own thing, not an attribute. A routine under $20 a month. One you can buy in a single pharmacy. One for humid summer
Which of my columns: new, this is our original bit

Name: skc:hasListing
What it means, in normal words: Product to one positioned ingredient entry

Name: skc:listsIngredient
What it means, in normal words: Which ingredient that entry points to

Name: skc:hasIngredient
What it means, in normal words: Shortcut straight to the ingredient, so easy questions stay easy
Where I got it from: Ours, worked out by the reasoner

Name: skc:hasFunction
What it means, in normal words: What the ingredient does

Name: skc:restrictedUnder
What it means, in normal words: Which annex restricts it

Name: skc:accordingTo
What it means, in normal words: WHO says so. Leaves the door open for Lebanese rules later

Name: skc:suitableFor
What it means, in normal words: Product suits a skin type

Name: skc:addressesConcern
What it means, in normal words: Product helps with a concern

Name: schema:offers
What it means, in normal words: Product to Offer

Name: schema:seller
What it means, in normal words: Offer to Shop. Note the price sits on the OFFER, not the product

Name: skc:hasClaim
What it means, in normal words: Product to Claim

Name: skc:hasEvidenceLevel
What it means, in normal words: Claim to how much we trust it

Name: prov:wasAttributedTo
What it means, in normal words: Who said it

Name: prov:wasDerivedFrom
What it means, in normal words: The page we read it on

Name: skc:satisfiedBy
What it means, in normal words: A need met by a product, or by a few together

Name: skc:atPosition
What it means, in normal words: Where it sits in the INCI list, which is roughly concentration order
Where I got it from: The MVFM paper uses this too

Name: skc:cosingCoverage
What it means, in normal words: How much of the formula we found in the register

Name: skc:ingredientCount
What it means, in normal words: How many ingredients

Name: schema:price
What it means, in normal words: Sits on the Offer

Name: skc:priceSeenDate
What it means, in normal words: When that price was true

Name: SensitiveSafeProduct
What it means, in normal words: Any product where NONE of the ingredients is one of the 26 declarable allergens. We never list them, the software finds them. Should come out around 9,537

Name: AvailableInLebanon
What it means, in normal words: Any product with at least one offer from a Lebanese shop. Around 11,937

Name: ManufacturerStatedProduct
What it means, in normal words: Products where the manufacturer themselves made the claim. Around 4,460

Name: RegulatedProduct
What it means, in normal words: Has at least one restricted ingredient. Around 9,613

Name: FullyIdentifiedProduct
What it means, in normal words: Every single ingredient found in the register. Around 9,032

Name: NaturalClaimProduct
What it means, in normal words: Products sold as natural. Built so we can TEST them against the finding that 56% of natural INCI substances are classed as hazardous
